The faculty here are exceptional — knowledgeable, grounded, and truly living examples of yogic wisdom. Their way of teaching goes beyond books, connecting ancient texts to modern relevance. Every class encouraged reflection, dialogue, and self-discovery.

The teaching methodology is well-structured — beautifully balancing theory and practice. From the study of classical scriptures and Sanskrit to asana, pranayama, and meditation, everything is taught with authenticity and clarity. Regular discussions, projects, and presentations made the learning interactive and practical.

The campus environment is calm and supportive, ideal for inner focus. The library, classrooms, and practice halls are well-equipped, clean, and conducive to both study and sadhana. The administrative and support staff are also cooperative and efficient.

What I value most is the sense of community and integrity — a space where teachers and students grow together with mutual respect and genuine curiosity.

Overall, Kaivalyadham Mumbai provides a rare blend of academic depth, practical discipline, and spiritual grounding. It has not only shaped my professional path but also deepened my personal yoga journey.

featured_reviews.name: Simi Vinod
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you’re searching for a fitness experience that’s energizing, uplifting, and expertly guided, look no further than Galaxy Studio’s Zumba and aerial yoga classes. What truly sets this place apart is the incredible trainer, Gaurav.

Gaurav brings unmatched energy to the Zumba sessions—his choreography is fun, dynamic, and easy to follow no matter your experience level. He knows exactly how to read the room, pushing you when you need it, and cheering you on every step of the way. There’s never a dull moment; with Gaurav leading, you forget it’s a workout and just enjoy the rhythm.

And then there’s aerial yoga—equal parts graceful and empowering. Gaurav’s guidance here is calm, clear, and confidence-boosting. He pays attention to every individual’s form and makes sure you feel supported and safe as you stretch, flip, and float your way through each pose. It’s like he has this sixth sense for knowing exactly what each student needs to progress.

Whether you’re dancing your heart out or hanging upside down, Gaurav transforms every session into a personal triumph. Highly recommended for anyone who wants to move with joy and grow stronger in body and mind.

featured_reviews.name: Kirthika Vikraman
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’m Kirthika from Chennai. After going through few health challenges since 2020, I was searching for a genuine and affordable 200-hour Yoga TTC in order to make my body fit and peace in mind and also I love teaching and spreading my knowledge. I’m truly thankful to Inner World Yoga Academy (IWYA) for offering such a valuable course at a affordable  fee.
Our mentors, Bedi Mam and Monisha Mam, are incredibly knowledgeable, supportive, and passionate. They teach both theory and practicals with in-depth explanations, and are always available, even after class hours to clear doubts.

The syllabus is well-structured, covering everything from yoga history to pranayama, mudras and asanas. For each asana and mudra and pranayama we learn its benefits, awareness, and contraindication which is essential for every yoga teacher.

IWYA also adds joy to the learning journey by organizing a monthly Fun Day filled with games and music , and we can share anything you want. My classmates feel like sisters, creating a warm and motivating environment.

Joining IWYA has been one of the best decisions and now inner world mentors and class mates are like our family. I’ve made to learn and share the traditional and authentic methods of yoga. Even in Online yoga classes  also our mentors used to correct our asana posture for each and every one so if any one looking for best 200 hour yoga teacher training online without any doubts, you can  join to learn in depth of yoga.

featured_reviews.name: Vahitha M
featured_reviews.review_text: This course is an incredibly valuable resource for those seeking to prioritize self-care and enhance their well-being. It offers a dynamic and holistic approach, starting with foundational health practices that empower individuals to take charge of their own wellness. The program fosters a deep understanding of yoga, guiding students from the very basics all the way to mastery, even if they start with no prior knowledge of yoga. With expert guidance, students not only gain practical skills in yoga practice but also develop a profound understanding of its theory. The course nurtures both physical vitality and mental clarity, equipping individuals to thrive in their own lives and, ultimately, become skilled and knowledgeable yoga teachers themselves.

featured_reviews.name: Sameera Joshi
featured_reviews.review_text: I recently completed the 200-hour Yoga Teacher Training at innerworld yoga institute , and it was a deeply enriching experience. The instructors were exceptional, offering clear guidance on Hatha and Ashtanga techniques while fostering a supportive environment.  The curriculum balanced asanas, pranayama, meditation, and philosophy, though more practice teaching would have been beneficial. The school’s organization was seamless, with prompt communication and a welcoming community. This training transformed my personal practice, deepening my mindfulness and connection to yoga’s roots. It’s an experience I’ll carry forward in my teaching and life.
